Senses.Explanation: A fixed warning formula that bars every touch on the thing planted before the assembly. Nanquan Puyuan lets the bursar pull the mill all he likes but bars him from touching the heart-tree at its center, and the bursar has no word, Dahui Zonggao snaps the staff up at the question about the news and dares anyone to touch, on pain of a broken donkey-waist, Wuzhun Shifan shows the one treasure inside heaven and earth and tells them that if they do not see it, leave it where it has always lain, and Chushi Fanqi has them call the pillar a pillar and the lantern a lantern, with thirty blows for touching. Tianyin Yuanxiu finds the old sage lighting and stirring the ground on the tips of their eyelashes and bars every touch with thirty blows, Yinyuan Longqi hands out an amulet for going east and west, and if they have not got it, no touching, on pain of the donkey-waist, Baiyu Jingsi freezes the fortnight before the fifteenth so cold that not even the three-time buddhas and the founding teachers may touch it, and Daxiu Zhu throws down the staff, asks what it is, and cries out at the top of his voice not to touch it.
